criteria.description: Hyphenated sort mapping implemented in queryParser.ts: price-asc→priceAsc, price-desc→priceDesc, rating-desc→ratingDesc; camelCase values continue to be accepted.
criteria.evidence: queryParser.ts:24-28 defines HYPHENATED_SORT_MAP = { 'price-asc': 'priceAsc', 'price-desc': 'priceDesc', 'rating-desc': 'ratingDesc' }. Lines 29-31 apply the map before the VALID_SORT_OPTIONS lookup. VALID_SORT_OPTIONS (line 5) includes all camelCase variants (priceAsc, priceDesc, ratingDesc, nameAsc, nameDesc), ensuring backward compatibility. All three sort tests (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc) PASSED in vitest run --reporter=verbose. 18/18 tests passed.
